constraints.moon_separation_rule: For targets other than Moon, apply only while Moon's geometric centre is above 0 degrees.
constraints.horizon_rule: Maximum of baseline and circular linear user-entered horizon; unknown mask is not a surveyed clear horizon. Zenith ambiguity is unresolved and omitted.

method.frame: apparent topocentric AltAz; azimuth north through east
method.accuracy_note: Approximate offline model, not a precision JPL ephemeris. Numerical crossing tolerance is not physical accuracy. No terrain, atmosphere or visibility guarantee.
method.window_note: Geometric model windows, not visibility or eye-safety advice. Near-tangent crossings are marked unresolved; sub-second intervals are omitted.

moon.definition: geocentric geometric illuminated fraction; no surface/libration model
